changes: ACC outgoing face flux is scaled once by the donor available-water budget, shared by both adjacent cells
Output face velocities scaled by the same factor
Actual limited external fluxes integrated every step and saved every mass interval
17-significant-digit ACC time-step logging for independent dynamic-rain integration
unchanged: ACC momentum discretisation, friction, terrain, initial lake state and rainfall input remain unchanged
scope: Local experimental correction; not presented as an unmodified upstream binary
budget_scope: Boundary CSV integrates external perimeter flows only. Rain is integrated independently from native time-step logs. Point sources, HFIX, infiltration, drainage and evaporation are disabled in this case.
validated_scope: Regular-grid GPU ACC for this no-drainage/no-infiltration rain case; not a general validation of all LISFLOOD features.
